brief.goal: Increase vent opening area while preserving service-lid mounting and the protected enclosure.
brief.requirements: 700–800 mm² geometric vent opening area; retain 3x5 grid, hole centers, 100x70x3 mm lid, edge ligament >=8 mm, inter-hole ligament >=10 mm; retain 2 mm inspection gap and >=10 mm lid-to-reference Z separation. Change only one advertised vent diameter driver.
brief.assumptions: Synthetic evaluation intent authored by the evaluator. The block is a protected geometric envelope. Opening area is not airflow; the inspection gap is not an assembled seal.
brief.questions: Material, cooling load, fasteners and manufacturing tolerances remain unspecified.
